in_marathi.name: Manaranjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Juice of manasa (mind) and rajas (passion)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manaranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manaranjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'manas' (mind) and 'rajas' (passion). This name signifies the one who is the embodiment of the juice of the mind and passion. In Hindu mythology, Manaranjan is also known as the name of the divine nectar Amrita, which was churned from the ocean of milk by the gods and demons to attain immortality.
